Astronomer in Residence 2026 Blog: Follow Along with Us!

Prof. Robin Metcalfe AIR Term: Sep 21 - Sep 27 2026

Dr. Robin Metcalfe is a passionate science educator, with over 2 decades of experience teaching physics and astronomy courses at York University. She is also active in STEM-related public outreach events and gives space-themed talks to a wide variety of audiences in both Canada and the U.S. Through her teaching and outreach, Dr. Metcalfe seeks to strengthen our appreciation for what the night sky has to teach us, to gain perspective from our place in the Universe, and to value our precious planet Earth.
 
Link to Blog: https://www.yorku.ca/science/observatory/air/astronomer-in-residence-blog/
